title: Equipment & Vehicle Loans Pricing Policy — Contract Rate, Discounts, Floor and Rate Moves
content:
## Policy statement

1. **Fixed rate.** A fixed rate on an Equipment & Vehicle Loans loan is read from the product's fixed rate sheet: the rate of the first band whose longest term is at least the loan's term.
2. **Variable rate.** A variable rate is the Association Variable Base Rate in effect on the rate effective date, as registered in the operating-line rate setting, plus the product's variable rate spread.
3. **Discounts from either rate.** From either, the autopay discount and the relationship discount are taken as follows: the two are added and capped at the product's rate discount cap, and the result is rounded to 3 decimal places and may not be lower than the product's rate floor. (The clauses that stated when each discount applies are no longer in force; see the last section.)
4. **Dealer contracts.** An EquipDirect Dealer Contract carries the dealer-supported rate of its sheet and takes no discount of any kind, because dealer promotional rates exclude all other pricing.
5. **Discounts over time.** The relationship discount is fixed at funding and is not removed if the operating line later closes; the autopay discount is added or removed on the day autopay is enrolled or cancelled.
6. **Variable rate moves.** A variable rate moves on each base-rate history date for loans in active, deferred or nonaccrual status, and the installment is not changed by a rate move (the final installment absorbs the difference).

## Discount combination restated

The discount taken off the rate is the sum of the autopay part and the relationship part, but never more than the product's rate discount cap. The discounted rate is rounded to 3 decimal places and is never below the product's rate floor.

| Hypothetical (Irrigation System Loan: autopay 0.25, relationship 0.2, cap 0.4, floor 5.25) | Rate before discounts | Discount parts | Discount taken | Contract rate |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Both parts present, sum above the cap | 7.25 | 0.25 and 0.2 (sum 0.45) | 0.4 (cap) | 6.850 |
| Only the autopay part present | 7.25 | 0.25 and 0 | 0.25 | 7.000 |
| Neither part present | 7.25 | 0 and 0 | 0 | 7.250 |

## Points of judgement

- **Floor.** Hypothetical: a variable rate of 5.40 less a 0.25 discount gives 5.15; on a product whose floor is 5.25 the contract rate is 5.25.
- **Rate move and installment.** When a variable rate moves, the installment amount stays as it is; the final installment absorbs the difference.
- **Status for rate moves.** Variable-rate moves apply to loans in active, deferred or nonaccrual status.
- **Dealer contract.** An EquipDirect Dealer Contract takes no autopay discount and no relationship discount at any time.

## Clauses no longer in force

The following clauses of this policy are no longer in force; each is superseded by the current basis for the rate set on an autopay enrolment:

- "the autopay discount (the product's autopay rate discount) applies while the loan is enrolled in autopay" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.
- "the relationship discount (the product's relationship rate discount) applies when the member holds an operating line in active status on the funding date (at least one such line)" — no longer in force; superseded by the current basis.

The product figures named in this policy — the fixed rate sheet, the variable rate spread, the rate floor, the autopay and relationship discounts and the rate discount cap — remain those of the product's schedule of rates.

superseded_clauses: the autopay discount autopay_rate_discount_pct applies while autopay_enrolled is true
the relationship discount relationship_rate_discount_pct applies when the member holds an operating line in active status on the funding date (equipment_msr_active_operating_lines at least 1)
